_schema.id: stable string key (also used in replay logs)
_schema.name: human-readable card name
_schema.ops: operations value (0 for scoring cards, which cannot be played for Ops)
_schema.side: US | USSR | NEUTRAL (the side the event favors; NEUTRAL = playable by either)
_schema.period: EARLY_WAR | MID_WAR | LATE_WAR (when the card enters the deck)
_schema.scoring: true iff this is a regional scoring card (0 Ops, cannot be held past end of turn)
_schema.remove_after_event: true iff the card is removed from the game once its event fires
_schema.optional: true iff a Deluxe optional card, excluded from the default deck unless enabled
_schema.in_deck: false iff the card is never shuffled into the draw pile (only The China Card)
_schema.event_summary: null if this card has no implemented event yet (a no-op discard when played as event); otherwise a short, hand-maintained paraphrase of what events.py does mechanically -- NOT the physical card's printed text, and may drift from events.py (see docs/CARDS.md)

Duck_and_Cover.name: Duck and Cover
Duck_and_Cover.event_summary: DEFCON -1, then US +VP equal to (5 - new DEFCON).

Five_Year_Plan.name: Five Year Plan
Five_Year_Plan.event_summary: USSR randomly discards a card; if it's a USSR event, that event fires too.

Socialist_Governments.name: Socialist Governments
Socialist_Governments.event_summary: Remove up to 3 US Influence from Western Europe, max 2 per country.

Fidel.name: Fidel
Fidel.event_summary: USSR gains Control of Cuba outright.

Vietnam_Revolts.name: Vietnam Revolts
Vietnam_Revolts.event_summary: USSR +2 Influence in Vietnam; USSR gets +1 Op for the rest of the turn on plays fully spent in Southeast Asia.

Blockade.name: Blockade
Blockade.event_summary: Unless the US discards a 3+-Ops card, remove all US Influence from West Germany.

Korean_War.name: Korean War
Korean_War.event_summary: USSR war vs South Korea, win on 4-6, +2 VP and seizes target, +2 military ops on success.

Romanian_Abdication.name: Romanian Abdication
Romanian_Abdication.event_summary: USSR gains Control of Romania outright.

Arab_Israeli_War.name: Arab-Israeli War
Arab_Israeli_War.event_summary: USSR war vs Israel (blocked if Camp David Accords in effect), win on 4-6, +2 VP, +2 military ops.

COMECON.name: COMECON
COMECON.event_summary: USSR +1 Influence each to 4 non-US-controlled Eastern Europe countries.

Nasser.name: Nasser
Nasser.event_summary: USSR +2 Influence in Egypt; remove half (round up) of US Influence there.

Warsaw_Pact_Formed.name: Warsaw Pact Formed
Warsaw_Pact_Formed.event_summary: Branch: remove all US Influence from 4 Eastern Europe countries, OR USSR +5 Influence there (max 2/country); enables NATO.

De_Gaulle_Leads_France.name: De Gaulle Leads France
De_Gaulle_Leads_France.event_summary: Remove 2 US / +1 USSR Influence in France; NATO no longer protects France.

Captured_Nazi_Scientist.name: Captured Nazi Scientist
Captured_Nazi_Scientist.event_summary: Phasing side advances one Space Race box (its VP too).

Truman_Doctrine.name: Truman Doctrine
Truman_Doctrine.event_summary: Remove all USSR Influence from one uncontrolled European country.

Olympic_Games.name: Olympic Games
Olympic_Games.event_summary: Opponent chooses: a 2-die contest (sponsor +2, winner +2 VP) or boycott (DEFCON -1, sponsor conducts 4 Ops).

NATO.name: NATO
NATO.event_summary: USSR may no longer Coup, Realign, or play Brush War against US-controlled Europe (requires Marshall Plan or Warsaw Pact Formed).

Independent_Reds.name: Independent Reds
Independent_Reds.event_summary: US Influence in one chosen Eastern European country is raised to match USSR's there.

Marshall_Plan.name: Marshall Plan
Marshall_Plan.event_summary: US +1 Influence each to 7 non-USSR-controlled Western Europe countries; enables NATO.

Indo_Pakistani_War.name: Indo-Pakistani War
Indo_Pakistani_War.event_summary: Attacker's war vs India or Pakistan (their choice), win on 4-6, +2 VP, +2 military ops.

Containment.name: Containment
Containment.event_summary: All US Operations +1 for the rest of the turn.

US_Japan_Mutual_Defense_Pact.name: US/Japan Mutual Defense Pact
US_Japan_Mutual_Defense_Pact.event_summary: US gains Control of Japan; USSR may never Coup/Realign against Japan again.

Suez_Crisis.name: Suez Crisis
Suez_Crisis.event_summary: Remove up to 4 US Influence total from France/UK/Israel, max 2 per country.

East_European_Unrest.name: East European Unrest
East_European_Unrest.event_summary: Remove USSR Influence from 3 Eastern Europe countries (1 each Early/Mid War, 2 each Late War).

Decolonization.name: Decolonization
Decolonization.event_summary: USSR +1 Influence each to 4 countries in Africa and/or Southeast Asia.

Red_Scare_Purge.name: Red Scare/Purge
Red_Scare_Purge.event_summary: Opponent's Operations -1 (min 1) for the rest of the turn.

UN_Intervention.name: UN Intervention
UN_Intervention.event_summary: It has no event of its own. Its effect triggers separately: while you hold it, playing an opponent's implemented, eligible event card offers an extra 'un_intervention' mode on that card, cancelling its event and using its Ops instead; this card is then discarded automatically.

De_Stalinization.name: De-Stalinization
De_Stalinization.event_summary: USSR relocates up to 4 Influence: remove from anywhere it has some, then re-place the same number in non-US-controlled countries, max 2 per country.

Nuclear_Test_Ban.name: Nuclear Test Ban
Nuclear_Test_Ban.event_summary: Phasing side +VP equal to (DEFCON - 2), then DEFCON improves 2 levels.

Formosan_Resolution.name: Formosan Resolution
Formosan_Resolution.event_summary: While the US controls Taiwan, it scores as an Asian Battleground; nullified once the US plays the China Card (not when the USSR does).

Brush_War.name: Brush War
Brush_War.event_summary: Attacker's war vs any stability-1-or-2 country (their choice), win on 3-6, +1 VP, +3 military ops.

Arms_Race.name: Arms Race
Arms_Race.event_summary: If the phasing side leads on the Military Operations track, +3 VP if it also meets the DEFCON threshold, else +1 VP.

Cuban_Missile_Crisis.name: Cuban Missile Crisis
Cuban_Missile_Crisis.event_summary: DEFCON set to 2; a Coup by the flagged opponent this turn loses them the game; they may defuse at the start of any of their action rounds this turn by removing 2 Influence from Cuba (USSR) or West Germany/Turkey (US).

Nuclear_Subs.name: Nuclear Subs
Nuclear_Subs.event_summary: US Battleground coups don't degrade DEFCON this turn.

Quagmire.name: Quagmire
Quagmire.event_summary: Traps the US: each action round it must discard a 2+-Ops card and roll a die (1-4 frees it, 5-6 stays trapped); with no such card, the round is wasted with no roll (any scoring card in hand is still forced into play).

Salt_Negotiations.name: SALT Negotiations
Salt_Negotiations.event_summary: DEFCON +2; both sides' coup rolls -1 for the rest of the turn; phasing side may reclaim one non-scoring card from the discard pile.

Bear_Trap.name: Bear Trap
Bear_Trap.event_summary: Traps the USSR: each action round it must discard a 2+-Ops card and roll a die (1-4 frees it, 5-6 stays trapped); with no such card, the round is wasted with no roll (any scoring card in hand is still forced into play).

Summit.name: Summit
Summit.event_summary: Both roll +1 per region Dominated/Controlled; winner +2 VP and may raise/lower/leave DEFCON.

How_I_Learned_to_Stop_Worrying.name: How I Learned to Stop Worrying
How_I_Learned_to_Stop_Worrying.event_summary: Set DEFCON to any level, then +5 to the phasing side's Military Operations track.

Junta.name: Junta
Junta.event_summary: Phasing side +2 Influence in a single Central/South America country, then may make one free Coup or Realignment there.

Kitchen_Debates.name: Kitchen Debates
Kitchen_Debates.event_summary: If the US controls more Battlegrounds than the USSR, US +2 VP.

Missile_Envy.name: Missile Envy
Missile_Envy.event_summary: Exchange for the opponent's highest-Ops card (opponent breaks ties); Missile Envy passes to them and they must play it for Ops on their next action round; the taker uses the taken card for Ops, or its Event if eligible.

We_Will_Bury_You.name: We Will Bury You
We_Will_Bury_You.event_summary: DEFCON -1; USSR +3 VP at end of turn unless the US plays UN Intervention first.

Brezhnev_Doctrine.name: Brezhnev Doctrine
Brezhnev_Doctrine.event_summary: All USSR Operations +1 for the rest of the turn.

Portuguese_Empire_Crumbles.name: Portuguese Empire Crumbles
Portuguese_Empire_Crumbles.event_summary: USSR +2 Influence in Angola and +2 in SE African States.

South_African_Unrest.name: South African Unrest
South_African_Unrest.event_summary: Branch: USSR +2 Influence in South Africa, OR +1 there and +2 in an adjacent country.

Willy_Brandt.name: Willy Brandt
Willy_Brandt.event_summary: USSR +1 VP, +1 Influence in West Germany; NATO no longer protects West Germany.

Muslim_Revolution.name: Muslim Revolution
Muslim_Revolution.event_summary: Remove all US Influence from 2 of a fixed Middle-East/North-Africa country list.

ABM_Treaty.name: ABM Treaty
ABM_Treaty.event_summary: DEFCON +1, then phasing side conducts 4 Ops of Operations.

Cultural_Revolution.name: Cultural Revolution
Cultural_Revolution.event_summary: If US holds the China Card, USSR takes it face up; else USSR +1 VP.

Flower_Power.name: Flower Power
Flower_Power.event_summary: USSR +2 VP every time the US plays a war card, until An Evil Empire is played.

OPEC.name: OPEC
OPEC.event_summary: USSR +VP equal to how many of a fixed oil-country list it controls (unless North Sea Oil is in effect).

Colonial_Rear_Guards.name: Colonial Rear Guards
Colonial_Rear_Guards.event_summary: US +1 Influence each to 4 countries in Africa/Southeast Asia.

Panama_Canal_Returned.name: Panama Canal Returned
Panama_Canal_Returned.event_summary: US +1 Influence each in Panama, Costa Rica, Venezuela.

Camp_David_Accords.name: Camp David Accords
Camp_David_Accords.event_summary: US +1 VP, +1 Influence each in Israel/Jordan/Egypt; blocks Arab-Israeli War.

Puppet_Governments.name: Puppet Governments
Puppet_Governments.event_summary: US +1 Influence each to up to 3 countries with zero Influence from either side.

Grain_Sales_to_Soviets.name: Grain Sales to Soviets
Grain_Sales_to_Soviets.event_summary: One USSR card is randomly revealed; US plays it in full (Event or Ops) or returns it (US conducts 2 Ops instead); if the USSR hand is empty, US just gets 2 Ops.

John_Paul_II_Elected_Pope.name: John Paul II Elected Pope
John_Paul_II_Elected_Pope.event_summary: Remove 2 USSR / +1 US Influence in Poland; enables Solidarity.

Latin_American_Death_Squads.name: Latin American Death Squads
Latin_American_Death_Squads.event_summary: +1 to the phasing side's own coup rolls, -1 to the opponent's, in Central/South America for the rest of the turn.

OAS_Founded.name: OAS Founded
OAS_Founded.event_summary: US +1 Influence each to up to 2 Central/South America countries.

Nixon_Plays_The_China_Card.name: Nixon Plays The China Card
Nixon_Plays_The_China_Card.event_summary: If the US already holds the China Card: US +2 VP. If the USSR holds it: the US takes it face down (unusable this turn). No discard-to-keep option.

Sadat_Expels_Soviets.name: Sadat Expels Soviets
Sadat_Expels_Soviets.event_summary: Remove all USSR Influence from Egypt; US +1 Influence there.

Shuttle_Diplomacy.name: Shuttle Diplomacy
Shuttle_Diplomacy.event_summary: At the next Middle East or Asia scoring, one USSR-controlled Battleground doesn't count.

The_Voice_Of_America.name: The Voice of America
The_Voice_Of_America.event_summary: Remove up to 4 USSR Influence from non-Europe countries, max 2 per country.

Liberation_Theology.name: Liberation Theology
Liberation_Theology.event_summary: USSR +1 Influence each to up to 3 Central America countries, max 2 per country.

Ussuri_River_Skirmish.name: Ussuri River Skirmish
Ussuri_River_Skirmish.event_summary: If USSR holds the China Card, US takes it face up; else US +4 Influence in Asia, max 2 per country.

Ask_Not_What_Your_Country_Can_Do_For_You.name: Ask Not What Your Country Can Do For You
Ask_Not_What_Your_Country_Can_Do_For_You.event_summary: Phasing side may discard any number of non-scoring hand cards and redraw that many.

Alliance_for_Progress.name: Alliance for Progress
Alliance_for_Progress.event_summary: US +VP equal to Battlegrounds it controls in Central/South America.

One_Small_Step.name: One Small Step
One_Small_Step.event_summary: If behind on the Space Race, phasing side advances 2 boxes; VP is scored for the second box only, not the first.

Iranian_Hostage_Crisis.name: Iranian Hostage Crisis
Iranian_Hostage_Crisis.event_summary: Remove all US Influence from Iran, USSR +2 there; makes Terrorism hit the US twice.

The_Iron_Lady.name: The Iron Lady
The_Iron_Lady.event_summary: US +1 VP, USSR +1 Influence in Argentina, remove all USSR Influence from UK; blocks Socialist Governments.

Reagan_Bombs_Libya.name: Reagan Bombs Libya
Reagan_Bombs_Libya.event_summary: US +VP equal to (USSR Influence in Libya // 2).

Star_Wars.name: Star Wars
Star_Wars.event_summary: Only while the US leads the Space Race: US takes a non-scoring card from the discard pile and fires its event immediately.

North_Sea_Oil.name: North Sea Oil
North_Sea_Oil.event_summary: OPEC can no longer be played as an event; US gets one extra action round this turn.

The_Reformer.name: The Reformer
The_Reformer.event_summary: USSR +1 Influence in Europe, total 6 if USSR is ahead on VP else 4, max 2 per country; USSR may no longer coup in Europe.

Marine_Barracks_Bombing.name: Marine Barracks Bombing
Marine_Barracks_Bombing.event_summary: Remove all US Influence from Lebanon; remove up to 2 more US Influence from the rest of the Middle East.

Soviets_Shoot_Down_KAL_007.name: Soviets Shoot Down KAL-007
Soviets_Shoot_Down_KAL_007.event_summary: DEFCON -1, US +2 VP; if the US controls South Korea, US then gets 4 Ops restricted to Influence/Realignment (no Coup).

Glasnost.name: Glasnost
Glasnost.event_summary: USSR +2 VP, DEFCON +1; if The Reformer is in effect, USSR then gets 4 Ops restricted to Influence/Realignment (no Coup).

Ortega_Elected_in_Nicaragua.name: Ortega Elected in Nicaragua
Ortega_Elected_in_Nicaragua.event_summary: Remove all US Influence from Nicaragua; USSR gets a free Coup-only (no Realignment) op vs a Nicaragua neighbor.

Terrorism.name: Terrorism
Terrorism.event_summary: Opponent randomly discards a card (twice if USSR plays it after Iranian Hostage Crisis).

Iran_Contra_Scandal.name: Iran-Contra Scandal
Iran_Contra_Scandal.event_summary: US Realignment rolls are -1 for the rest of the turn.

Chernobyl.name: Chernobyl
Chernobyl.event_summary: US names a region; USSR may not add Influence there via Operations for the rest of the turn.

Latin_American_Debt_Crisis.name: Latin American Debt Crisis
Latin_American_Debt_Crisis.event_summary: Unless the US discards a 3+-Ops card, USSR doubles its Influence in up to 2 South America countries.

Tear_Down_This_Wall.name: Tear Down This Wall
Tear_Down_This_Wall.event_summary: Cancels Willy Brandt; US +3 Influence in East Germany; US gets a free Coup-or-Realignment op in Europe.

Aldrich_Ames_Remix.name: Aldrich Ames Remix
Aldrich_Ames_Remix.event_summary: USSR sees the US hand and picks one card the US must discard.

Pershing_II_Deployed.name: Pershing II Deployed
Pershing_II_Deployed.event_summary: USSR +1 VP; remove up to 3 US Influence from Western Europe, max 1 per country.

Wargames.name: Wargames
Wargames.event_summary: Only at DEFCON 2: phasing side may give the opponent 6 VP and end the game now, or decline.

Solidarity.name: Solidarity
Solidarity.event_summary: US +3 Influence in Poland (requires John Paul II Elected Pope to have fired).

Iran_Iraq_War.name: Iran-Iraq War
Iran_Iraq_War.event_summary: Attacker's war vs Iran or Iraq (their choice), win on 4-6, +2 VP, +2 military ops.

Defectors.name: Defectors
Defectors.event_summary: A US headline of Defectors discards the USSR's headlined card unresolved. Separately, if the USSR plays it in a normal action round (Event or Ops, not Space Race), US +1 VP. A USSR headline or a US action-round play have no effect.

The_Cambridge_Five.name: The Cambridge Five
The_Cambridge_Five.event_summary: USSR +1 Influence in a country from a region the US holds a scoring card for (blocked during Late War).

Special_Relationship.name: Special Relationship
Special_Relationship.event_summary: Only eligible while the US controls the UK. If NATO is not in effect: US +1 Influence to a UK neighbor. If NATO is in effect: US +2 Influence to one Western Europe country, and US +2 VP.

NORAD.name: NORAD
NORAD.event_summary: If Canada is US-controlled, whenever DEFCON moves to 2, US adds 1 Influence to a country where it already has some.

Che.name: Che
Che.event_summary: USSR makes a free Coup vs a non-Battleground country in Central/South America/Africa; if it removes any US Influence, a second free Coup vs a different such country.

Our_Man_In_Tehran.name: Our Man in Tehran
Our_Man_In_Tehran.event_summary: US looks at the top up to 5 draw-pile cards one at a time, keeping or removing each; kept cards are reshuffled back in.

Yuri_and_Samantha.name: Yuri and Samantha
Yuri_and_Samantha.event_summary: USSR +1 VP for every US coup attempt, for the rest of the game.

AWACS_Sale_to_Saudis.name: AWACS Sale to Saudis
AWACS_Sale_to_Saudis.event_summary: US +2 Influence in Saudi Arabia; blocks Muslim Revolution.
